reviews.title: Crooked/mis-aligned holes on every chair
reviews.body: Ordered multiple. All of the seat bases (see picture) that attached to the left and right leg assemblies have mis-drilled / mis-aligned holes so chair goes together crooked, if al all! I tried to make them work but they are so crooked that you can't get the back on. Not to mention they looks crooked.

features: Stylish and flexible design is ideal for office reception areas to waiting areas and more.
Thickly padded seat cushion relieves pressure points at the back of the knees.
Visible clean-out area between the back and seat prevents dirt and debris build-up.
Strong metal frame withstands heavy use and offers added durability and strength.
Wall-saver leg design helps protect against wall damage.
